bridges while adopting the official composite-routing and Ollama integrations.

Review result: the backend changes register new official composite-route and

They do not alter the custom updater contracts, so no semantic port into the
custom targets is required. The official source changes are retained.

## Database gate

Database semantics changed and automatic publication must remain blocked until
the exact database fingerprint is approved:

- Normalized database fingerprint:
  `042048b5d223e47cc2088393444742e71ee1a0360af1a2580513b12a4b08b473`
- `backend/ent/migrate/schema.go`
- `backend/ent/schema/composite_model_route.go`
- `backend/ent/schema/group.go`
- `backend/migrations/172_composite_model_routes.sql`
- `backend/migrations/185_group_reasoning_effort_policy.sql`
- `backend/migrations/186_alipay_mobile_precreate_deep_link.sql`
- `backend/migrations/186_group_auth_cache_image_generation.sql`

The migrations create `composite_model_routes`, add the group reasoning policy
fields, seed the disabled Alipay mobile deep-link setting, and update the group
authentication-cache invalidation function. They are transactional and use
full migration filenames for ordering/accounting; the duplicate numeric
prefixes do not replace one another.

An inherited official parity difference was recorded without modifying
official code: the SQL migration defines `ON DELETE CASCADE` and partial
indexes for composite routes, while the generated Ent schema represents a
`NoAction` foreign key and ordinary indexes. Production SQL was not executed.
A database-copy rehearsal, backup verification, and application/database
rollback plan are required before exact-revision approval.

## Conflict resolution

- `backend/cmd/server/wire_gen.go`: regenerated with Go 1.26.5 and the official
  Wire command after merging `backend/cmd/server/wire.go`. The result retains
  the custom updater/moderation providers and `provideApplication` bridge, and
  includes the official `OllamaCloudUsageService` provider and cleanup step.
- No other file required textual conflict resolution.

- Wire generation: passed; a second `go generate ./cmd/server` run produced no

- Targeted backend tests passed for `./internal/custom/updater`,
  `./internal/custom/moderation`, `./internal/handler`, `./internal/service`,
  and `./cmd/server`.
- Full `go test ./...` reached one pre-existing Windows timing fluctuation:
  `TestContentModerationRuntimeSnapshotRefreshFailureKeepsStaleConfig`.
  Its test Blob (`2b34d1fa578d1d71927ea0b3f8cbbae033c41ab0`) and implementation
  Blob (`b073bd45e55f3758dc6dee2d59c69435a7a939fb`) match pre-upgrade custom
  `main`, and v0.1.164 does not change either file. Ten isolated Windows runs
  produced three passes and seven failures around the one-nanosecond TTL.
  Required Linux CI remains the hard gate; no official test or implementation
  was changed to hide the inherited platform fluctuation.
- Frontend frozen install with pnpm 9.15.9, lint, typecheck, full Vitest, and
  production build passed. The custom rollback API test was corrected to
  assert the existing 900000 ms request timeout; production code was not
  changed.
- Database-boundary report mode passed with `database_changed=true` and the
  normalized fingerprint recorded above.
- Custom release safety, rehearsal Compose safety, upstream synchronization
  safety, and install-token checks passed under Git Bash. The release fixture

- Local golangci-lint and GoReleaser snapshot preflight were not run because

- No production database, Tag, Release, image, or deployment was changed.
